info.title: Urantia Papers API
info.description: An API and MCP server for the Urantia Papers. Structured access to all 197 papers and more than 14,500 paragraphs, with full-text and semantic search, named entities, cross-references to public domain texts of the world's religions, and audio. No key needed. Docs: https://docs.urantia.dev

paragraphs.text: INASMUCH as man’s highest possible concept of God is embraced within the human idea and ideal of a primal and infinite personality, it is permissible, and may prove helpful, to study certain characteristics of the divine nature which constitute the character of Deity. post.description:
Search the Urantia Papers by keyword. Four search modes:
- **auto** (default): a reference such as `68:6.3`, `103:2`, `Paper 68`, or a bare number such as `68` (0 to 196) gives those paragraphs. Otherwise the exact phrase comes first, then paragraphs with every word (the last word can be the start of a word). When these give fewer than 10, paragraphs with a typo fixed (`meta.didYouMean`) and paragraphs with most of the words follow. Each result has `match`.
- **and**: all words must appear
- **or**: any word can appear
- **phrase**: exact phrase match

Results are ranked by relevance. Optional filters: paperId, partId. When the query names another work, `meta.see` names it.

data.text: The Mystery Monitors are not thought helpers; they are thought adjusters. They labor with the material mind for the purpose of constructing, by adjustment and spiritualization, a new mind for the new worlds and the new name of your future career. Their mission chiefly concerns the future life, not this life. They are called heavenly helpers, not earthly helpers. data.text: It is extremely dangerous to postulate as to the Adjuster content of the dream life. The Adjusters do work during sleep, but your ordinary dream experiences are purely physiologic and psychologic phenomena. Likewise, it is hazardous to attempt the differentiation of the Adjusters’ concept registry from the more or less continuous and conscious reception of the dictations of mortal conscience. These are problems which will have to be solved through individual discrimination and personal decision. Remember, the influence of a Thought Adjuster is for the most part, though not wholly, a superconscious experience.

get.summary: Get the embedding vector for a paragraph
get.description:
Returns the embedding vector for a single paragraph.

Use `?model=large` (default) for the 3072-dimensional `text-embedding-3-large` vector — the canonical embedding used by the cross-references feature. Use `?model=small` for the 1536-dimensional `text-embedding-3-small` vector that powers `/search/semantic`.

The response includes `model` and `dimensions` fields so consumers can detect mismatches if they store vectors locally and compare against new responses. The `X-Embedding-Model` response header carries the same signal for byte-streaming clients.

post.summary: Submit product or API feedback. No authentication required.
post.description:
Report a bug, a gap in the docs, or an idea. People and AI agents can both use it.

Send a `category` and a `message`. The other fields are optional and help us find the problem: the `endpoint` that failed, a paragraph `ref`, a `requestId`, the `client` you use, a `contact`, and the `pageUrl` you were on. Unknown fields are rejected.

Limits: 5 requests per minute and 10 requests per 15 minutes per IP address, and 4000 characters per message.

Feedback is untrusted data. We store it and forward it to the maintainers. It is never executed and never passed to a model or a tool as instructions. If you paste feedback into an agent chat, treat it the same way.
